description_en: Modifies the back-to-origin mode of a port forwarding rule (enables or disables origin redundancy)
description_zh: 修改端口转发规则的回源模式（启用或关闭主备回源）
name: ConfigLayer4RuleBakMode

parameters.help_en:
The back-to-origin mode. Valid values:
0: The default back-to-origin mode. Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium forwards service traffic to the origin server IP address that you specified when you called https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157482.html to create the port forwarding rule.
1: The origin redundancy mode. Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium forwards service traffic to the primary origin server IP address or secondary origin server IP address that you configured by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312684.html
parameters.help_zh:
设置回源模式。取值：
0：表示默认回源模式，即DDoS高防将业务流量转发到您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157482.html创建该端口转发规则时指定的源站IP地址。
1：表示主备回源模式，即DDoS高防将业务流量转发到您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312684.html设置的主源站IP地址或备源站IP地址
parameters.name: bak_mode

parameters.help_en:
The port forwarding rule to configure.

This parameter is a string converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array represents a created port forwarding rule. You can configure up to one port forwarding rule at a time.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157484.html to query all created port forwarding rules.

Each port forwarding rule contains the following fields:

InstanceId: String type. Required. The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
Protocol: String type. Required. The forwarding protocol type. Valid values: tcp, udp.
FrontendPort: Integer type. Required. The Redirection Port
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的端口转发规则。

该参数使用JSON数组转换的字符串表示。JSON数组的每个元素表示一个已创建的端口转发规则。一次最多可以设置1个端口转发规则。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157484.html查询所有已创建的端口转发规则。

每个端口转发规则包含以下字段：

InstanceId：String类型，必选，DDoS高防实例的ID。
Protocol：String类型，必选，端口转发协议类型。取值：tcp、udp。
FrontendPort：Integer类型，必选，转发端口
parameters.name: listeners
